changedbehavior.delta: Signed-in HTTP(S) pages with no known landed Source now show a 'Not yet a Source' notice with Capture or Save action. Lookup-in-progress, lookup-failed, saving, non-web, and already-saved states suppress that notice. Unsaved capture wording now explains local retention and Source landing. Markdown portions are normalized to plain text (links retain labels, images/fences/separators drop, list markers drop, table cells split) to match server semantics.
Visible terminology clarifies that rows are Sources and deletion removes the Source across AI Matrx; behavior remains covered by existing Source list/detail/delete cases.
A failed match lookup is stored separately from a successful empty result, stale candidate matches are cleared while a retry is pending, and a retry action plus failure-specific message is shown.
A failed intent claim now produces an inline sidepanel alert with an Open Scrape recovery action. Existing failure cases already cover launch failure, fail-closed claims, and non-replay.

Both context builders replace prior_capture with page_source: source (ID/title/time), not_yet_a_source (how to make it one), or unknown (lookup failure). The model receives an explicit action/remedy and lookup errors are not collapsed into absence.

Admitted credential execution reports closed, value-free execution stages; when no post-submit observation is available the controller classifies a terminal reason from current binding, deadline, and last stage instead of always reporting configuration_error.

affectedcases.impact: Add assertions for the signed-in not-yet-a-Source notice/action and ensure a failed lookup displays unknown rather than this notice.
Already covers failed prior-save lookup; retain and extend to ensure the new notice is suppressed while lookup is unknown.
Already covers Capture claim failure; confirm the sidepanel's Open Scrape alert is visible and actionable.
Generic Vault case should include match-lookup refusal, truthful error versus empty result, no stale candidate action, and successful retry.
Composer send now carries page_source context in place of prior_capture; verify all three statuses reach the request.
Pilot inherits the page_source context and also exercises more specific local-browser terminal outcomes.

newcaseproposals.title: Show not-yet-a-Source state with its next action
steps: Open Scrape on a signed-in HTTP(S) page not present in Sources.
Check the notice and choose Capture; after capture, choose Save.
Repeat with an existing Source and with a failed lookup.
expected: An absent Source is described as not yet a Source with the correct next action; a known Source shows saved status; unknown lookup state is explicit and never presented as not-yet-saved.

newcaseproposals.title: Distinguish failed site-login lookup from no matches and retry
steps: On a supported login page, force the browser-login match request to fail.
Confirm the error and Retry control appear and prior candidates are not actionable.
expected: Failure is not shown as an empty successful result; candidates from an earlier page or actor are cleared; retry runs for the same current tab, page, and actor and then displays the returned result.

newcaseproposals.title: Send explicit page Source status in Chat context
steps: Send from a known Source page, a page without a landed Source, and while Source lookup fails.
expected: The outgoing context carries exactly the corresponding source, not_yet_a_source, or unknown status; the not-yet state includes the Scrape Save action and unknown never claims absence.

newcaseproposals.title: Pilot receives page Source status and truthful local-browser terminal outcomes
steps: Send Pilot work from source, not-yet, and unknown pages; exercise an admitted credential operation with a controlled changed binding, unavailable field, or lost post-submit document.
expected: Pilot context carries the explicit page Source state; a terminal operation reports a reason matching its actual failed stage and never mislabels an unavailable observation as configuration_error.
